---
name: Code job
about: A job for the Chat to Code Loop. The issue body is the assignment.
title: "Job: "
labels: job
---

Mission
One line naming the mission and its Chat to Code job number.

Goal
One of: Finish Week 0 of Cal's course, Launch Ember, AI work runs without me, or a new plain-words goal.

Objective
What this job changes and why, with the decision that authorizes it.

Files in scope
The only files the builder may touch, one per line, marked (new) when the job creates it.

Acceptance checks
Numbered checks, each one a command or test anyone can run.

Decisions already made
Rulings the builder follows without asking again, each with its Decision Log date.
